meta.title: Malaysia car registrations by model — paultan.org car-sales-data (source: JPJ via data.gov.my registration_transactions_car)
meta.monthly_window_note: Monthly history is retained for the latest 36 months only; all-time rankings cover 2000-01..current.
meta.note: Paultan aggregates the official JPJ per-transaction dataset (registration_transactions_car). EV = fuel electric; Hybrid = hybrid_petrol + hybrid_diesel (incl PHEV). share_pct is the share of that fuel class within the queried period.
